title: Bijan Goes First, Kirk Goes Early, Mahomes Goes Dead Last: Grading the Buckaroo Draft
dek: Eight teams, 128 picks and one rookie at the top of the board kicked off the road to Buckaroo Bowl IV, with a few picks that will have the group chat busy all week.
body: The Buckaroo Football League's first eight-team draft is in the books, and the opening pick went to someone who had never sat through a fantasy draft. Zoe, picking first for Ghostu-Spider SZN, took Bijan Robinson without blinking. Philly followed with Jahmyr Gibbs, Kai grabbed Ja'Marr Chase as the first receiver, Brucie took Christian McCaffrey at 4, Habib went Puka Nacua at 5, Randy landed Jonathan Taylor at 6, and JMoney chose Ladd McConkey at 7. Sonny, picking last as the defending champ, turned the corner with Jaxon Smith-Njigba at 8 and James Cook III at 9. There were no keepers on the board, so all 128 picks were fresh.

The board moved in waves. Round 1 split evenly at four running backs and four receivers, then Round 2 went heavy on wideouts with six, and Round 3 flipped hard: seven of eight picks were running backs, with George Pickens the only receiver taken. Round 4 swung back to six receivers. Quarterbacks waited a long time, as Lamar Jackson didn't go until pick 33 before Josh Allen and Joe Burrow followed in Round 5, and four kickers came off the board together in Round 13.

Now for the picks that'll get talked about. Jordan took Christian Kirk at pick 10, ahead of Amon-Ra St. Brown (11), CeeDee Lamb (12) and Justin Jefferson (14), the biggest reach of the night by where players went relative to each other. To his credit, JMoney recovered nicely: Garrett Wilson at 42, Malik Nabers at 55 and Marvin Harrison Jr. at 87 look like real bargains, and he loaded up on six running backs including Ashton Jeanty and Jeremiyah Love. Randy got the night's other big surprise, taking Brandon Aubrey at 54 as the first kicker. No one else took a kicker until Round 12, and Randy also took the first defense, Rams D/ST, at 86.

The steals of Round 2 went to the managers who waited. Randy got Amon-Ra at 11, Habib got CeeDee at 12, and Mekhi got Jefferson at 14, so the Dawgs have Chase and Jefferson as their top two receivers despite drafting from overseas. Kai then took the first tight end, Trey McBride, at 30 and came back for Brock Bowers at 35, cornering the top of the position. He also found Josh Jacobs at pick 110 and used a Round 15 pick on Harrison Mevis, a kicker currently listed as a free agent. That's a bold move for a manager who usually wins on the waiver wire.

Zoe's rookie draft looked confident. After Bijan, she added A.J. Brown, Saquon Barkley, Nico Collins and the first quarterback in Lamar, then backed him up with Kyler Murray in Round 13. She also took two Packers, MarShawn Lloyd and Tucker Kraft, which fits her Wisconsin roots. Then, in a league full of Chicago guys, Z² used her final pick on Cairo Santos, the Bears' kicker.

Brucie built around McCaffrey, Chris Olave, Kenneth Walker III and Zay Flowers, then took Josh Allen at 36 and DJ Moore in Round 8, giving the Chicago-born Bills fan a Buffalo stack. He also added Travis Kelce and D'Andre Swift. Alan paired Gibbs with De'Von Achane for one of the best backfields on the board, added Pickens, Emeka Egbuka and Davante Adams at receiver, and found Stefon Diggs at pick 127. Philly also took Bears Kyle Monangai and Luther Burden III, so expect some Chicago trade offers soon.

Kaushal put together a deep, balanced roster: Puka and CeeDee up top, then Drake London, Chase Brown, Breece Hall and Quinshon Judkins, with Drake Maye and Dak Prescott at quarterback and two kickers in Ka'imi Fairbairn and Jake Bates. Randy took Bears Colston Loveland at 38 and Caleb Williams in Round 8, and no one should expect him to trade either one. Sonny's title defense starts with Smith-Njigba, Cook, Travis Etienne Jr., Rashee Rice, DeVonta Smith and Terry McLaurin, plus back-to-back value picks in Jalen Hurts at 72 and George Kittle at 73. Then he took Patrick Mahomes with pick 121, a late steal from the guy who went from worst to first.

social.author: Buckaroo Football League
social.text: The 2026 draft is complete: 8 teams, 16 rounds, 128 picks. First at each position: RB Bijan Robinson (1), WR Ja'Marr Chase (3), TE Trey McBride (30), QB Lamar Jackson (33), K Brandon Aubrey (54), D/ST Rams (86). The road to Buckaroo Bowl IV starts now.

social.author: Draft Board Dave
social.text: Christian Kirk at 10. Amon-Ra at 11. CeeDee at 12. Jefferson at 14. Somebody check on JMoney's draft room.

social.author: Kicker Truther
social.text: Brandon Aubrey in ROUND SEVEN. The next kicker didn't go until Round 12. Randy saw something nobody else did.

social.author: Midwest Mel
social.text: Zoe drafts two Packers and then ends the night with the Bears' kicker. That's either clever trolling or peace talks.
